name: Price pressure

subjectOf.text: Because customers cannot afford to search for better priced code reviews and are forced into cartel pricing to obtain market acceptance of their products, cartelization undermines any form of downward price pressure.
subjectOf.abstract: Customers cannot afford to look for better priced code reviews and are forced into the cartel pricing to obtain market acceptance of their products. In turn, the cartelization of the market undermines any form of downward price pressure.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How DAOs Optimize Open-Source Code Reviews and Create Open-Source Standards (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3995709
scope_conditions: clients requiring market acceptance signals from audit firms

subjectOf.text: Because job posters cannot afford to shop for better priced reviews and must buy market acceptance, centralization of the code review market eliminates any form of downward price pressure.
subjectOf.abstract: In turn, the centralization of the market undermines any form of downward price pressure.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Code Review DAO (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4734750

subjectOf.text: Concentrated market power in code review undermines internal and external quality controls, leaving the public with no or very weak control over the quality of code review services, and it eliminates downward price pressure because job posters cannot afford to shop for better-priced reviews.
subjectOf.abstract: The centralized power also undermines attempts by other industry players to create internal or external controls on the quality of code reviews. As a result, the public has no or very weak control over the quality of code review services it receives.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, AI Learning - Decentralized Governance to Optimize Human Output Datasets for AI Learning (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4755632
scope_conditions: applies to the centralized code review market
